## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-07-03 — do not edit manually*

### File Read Caching
*~93,019 tokens/session saved*
- Avoid re-reading the same file multiple times within a session. Read each file once and reuse its contents from conversation history.
- The 146x read loop in prior sessions (~93k tokens) wastes more than any other pattern — it's the highest-value optimization.

### Todo Update Batching
*~1,868 tokens/session saved*
- Update todos in one comprehensive todowrite call per phase, not once per edit.
- The three todowrite loops (patterns repeating 5x, 4x, 3x with incremental state changes) reveal the agent micro-managing updates instead of batching them.

### Edit & Write Batching
*~180 tokens/session saved*
- Collect all related edits/writes for a phase, then execute them together before rebuilding.
- Avoid edit-read-edit cycles on the same file — batch multiple file changes atomically.

### Repo Search Scope
*~3,500 tokens/session saved*

- No task/plan/spec/roadmap/backlog/TODO files exist anywhere in this repo — confirmed via exhaustive globbing (`**/*task*`, `**/*TODO*`, `**/*plan*`, `**/*spec*`, `**/*implementation*`, `**/CHANGELOG*`, `**/*roadmap*`, `**/*backlog*`, etc. all return empty matches). This has been re-verified from scratch in 3 separate sessions — do NOT re-run this glob sweep; trust this note.
- Project context/requirements live only in README.md and two spec/architecture docs already summarized in PROGRESS.md — read those directly instead of globbing.

### Refactor Key Files
*~1,500 tokens/session saved*

- Known component/style files from the preloader/hero-cube/marquee/transitions refactor: `src/styles/components/preloader.css`, `src/components/ThreeCube.jsx` + `src/styles/components/threecube.css`, and files matching `section-wipe`. Their contents (and the architecture decision resolving the two conflicting spec docs re: hero cube approach) are already summarized — do not re-read full file bodies across sessions when a summary already exists in PROGRESS.md.

### Build Command
*~987 tokens/session saved*

- `npm run build 2>&1` (Vite) is this project's verify command. Batch multiple related edits together (a whole phase, not each file), then run one build — rebuilding after every single-file edit (8 rebuilds interleaved with ~30 single edits in one session) wastes ~1000 tokens/session for no extra signal.

### Reference Fetches
*~400 tokens/session saved*

- When fetching an external reference URL (e.g. `https://bpco.kr`) for content inspection, fetch once in `markdown` format only — fetching the same URL again in `html` format roughly doubles the payload for no new information.
